errors.text_span: за шест региона в Северозападна България
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies all six categories as regions in Northwestern Bulgaria. The first category, "Общо за страната", represents the national average for the entire country, not a region in the northwest.
The categories on the horizontal axis are not arranged in alphabetical order. The order is "Общо за страната", "Северозападен район", "Видин", "Враца", "Ловеч", "Монтана", which is not alphabetical.
The prompt asks to include representative values from the shortest and highest bars. The description does not provide any specific numerical values from the chart.

errors.text_span: а вътрешните стълби във всяка група са подредени по времеви ред, като най-надолу е 2016 г., а най-нагоре – 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The phrasing "най-надолу" (lowest) and "най-нагоре" (highest) is ambiguous and incorrect for describing the side-by-side arrangement of bars in a group. It suggests a stacked chart or refers to the bar values, rather than the left-to-right chronological ordering.
